messages.author: JoshMD
messages.text:
Would love other people to contribute to this as well but some info I think is important to show the player is

- Why unrest is growing/decreasing. This one is extremely important as it has huge consequences, and mine seemingly grows and decreases on a whim with no clear reasons why.

- Economic info in a province, such as unemployed people, open jobs

title: Expose Important Information To The User
